description: The Δ_λ chirality sign (-1)^{n(λ)}=q^{2n(λ)}|_{q=i} is the principal (ρ) Z-grading, NOT an intrinsic ribbon/pivotal/FS invariant (not FS indicator, not twist ratio, not self-twist). Δ_λ is a ρ-graded dimension. Closes the sign-operator identification; magnitude |Δ_λ|=dim open.

assertions.detail: ν_2(V_λ)=+1 for ALL λ (S_n reps real over ℚ); target (-1)^{n(λ)} is mixed (5+/2-) => not the FS indicator

assertions.detail: Δ_λ = sgn(w_0^{S_{λ'}})·dim(λ) = (q^{2n(λ)}|_{q=i})·dim(λ): principal-graded sign × ungraded dimension. Magnitude |Δ_λ|=dim open (Track A).

result.verdict: CLOSED (sign-operator identification): the Δ_λ chirality sign (-1)^{n(λ)} = q^{2n(λ)}|_{q=i} is NOT an intrinsic ribbon/pivotal/Frobenius-Schur invariant of V_λ — not the FS indicator (ν_2=+1 ∀λ, target mixed), not a sgn-twist ratio (=+1 ∀λ), not the ribbon self-twist (content-graded, misses). It IS the PRINCIPAL (ρ) Z-grading n(λ)=Σ row (s_λ(1,q,q²,…)=q^{n(λ)}·∏…), an EXTERNAL grading of the category, distinct from the content grading c=col-row that framings/JM see. Hence Δ_λ = (ρ-graded sign at ζ₄)·dim(λ) is a ρ-GRADED DIMENSION: the sign is the principal grading, the magnitude is the ordinary dimension. This closes the SIGN-operator question (a grading, not a twist). OPEN (Track A, gated): the magnitude |Δ_λ|=dim as a categorical closure. NOTHING wired.
